title: Visual Explainer: an agent skill that turns messy terminal output into styled HTML pages
description:
Visual Explainer is an agent skill that turns messy terminal output into styled HTML pages you'll actually want to share. No more ASCII art diagrams or broken table formatting — ask your coding agent for an architecture overview, diff review, or plan audit, and it generates a self-contained HTML page with real typography, dark mode, interactive Mermaid diagrams with zoom and pan.

https://github.com/nicobailon/visual-explainer
